title: Build a Stronger Glute with These 8 Moves
description: The glutes are the largest and most powerful muscle group in the body. These 8 targeted exercises will build rounder, stronger glutes without ever leaving your home.
author: Jake Reynolds

seo.title: 8 Best Glute Exercises to Build Stronger Glutes at Home
seo.description: Build stronger, rounder glutes at home with these 8 targeted exercises. With and without resistance band variations included.

pinterest.title: 8 Moves for Stronger Glutes at Home
pinterest.description: Build rounder, stronger glutes with these 8 home exercises.

content.text: The gluteus maximus, medius, and minimus work together for hip extension, abduction, and external rotation. Many people have underactive glutes from sitting all day — a condition called gluteal amnesia. These exercises actively re-engage and strengthen all three glute muscles.

items: Hip Thrust (with shoulder on bench or sofa) — best glute activator
Bulgarian Split Squat — unilateral strength and balance
Sumo Squat — wide stance for inner thigh and glute focus
Step-Up (using stairs or sturdy chair) — functional strength
Resistance Band Lateral Walk — gluteus medius activation

content.text: Use a resistance band around your knees during hip thrusts and bridges to dramatically increase gluteus medius activation and prevent knee cave.

items.question: How often should I train my glutes?
items.answer: The glutes are a large, resilient muscle group that can be trained 2–4 times per week with adequate rest. For maximum growth, focus on progressive overload — increase reps, resistance, or range of motion each week.

items.question: Why are my glutes not growing?
items.answer: Most common reasons: insufficient load/resistance, not training through full range of motion, not eating enough protein, inadequate recovery, or not focusing on the mind-muscle connection to activate glutes rather than letting quads dominate.
